ck: (27)sarkarasrinivasacarya evan vyavaharikapetasya patyatvanityatyapaksan tusayitva tvitiyananutya tusayati — yatiti avivata iti srutipratipatyapetasya paranartikatvaparaparyayapatyatvankikaresnatapinatasyEvankikaratavayorvivato na syatityarta evan petasya paroktavyavaharikatvanapyupetya tusananapihitan itanin vyavaharikatvaneva petasya netyaha — kutascetyatina sanyatityantena srutipratipatyapetasya vyavaharikatvan kasnatankikriyata ityarta utaran sankate — atvEteti paranartikatvEtetyarta virotapariharasyeti upayorapi srutyo paranartikapetapetapratipatakatvenyonyavirotat kalu petasrutervyavaharikapetaparatvanapetasrute paranartikapetaparatvanankikrtya tatparihara kriyate tasya ca virotapariharasya petasrute paranartikapetaparatvanapetasrute pratipasikapetaparatvanityankikarepi sananatvatityarta nanu vyavaharikapetasya patyatvanityatyapaksa eva svikriyate naca tatatve sruterpatyartakrahitvenaprananyaprasanka iti vacyan srutitatparyavisayartapatasyEvaprananye prayocakatvena srutipratipatyapatasyaprayocakatvat petasya ca srutipratipatyatvepi srutitatparyakocaratvapavatiti sankate — nanviti upapatitasya pratipatyasya apipretasya tatparyakocarasya anyateti yati tasya patacruteraprananyanankikriyate ta`rhyutana vE tevakava vahantityatyartavatapakasyapyaprananyan syat srutyutitasya tevakavananurtvavahitvasya patitatvat natantarertavataprananyasyestatvaninansakanata ityuktan kuta ityata aha — srutinaniti srutinan petanuvatitvatiti sanpanta apraptasyanuvatasanpavataha — pratyaksaprapteti nahan sarvacna ityatipratyaksapraptetyarta anuvate prayocananaha — neha naneti pratipantya sanatate neti nanu neha naneti
